items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: Jack Dupree and Father Toots as you all call it now. Yeah, yeah. Big Bramble, well he's dead now. He played trumpet.

ctx.x: Jack Dupree and Father Toots as you all call it now. Yeah, yeah. Big Bramble, well he's dead now. He played trumpet. Junior, Little Junior they called him, he played drums.
What was Little Junior's name? Do you remember? No. Big Bramble's name?

items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: And another little fella used to give me a hand, his name was Father Toots.

ctx.x: That was a pro-roar. Oh, yeah. That was around 40. Rowland was around 42, around 40 and 41. Around 40? Around 39 and 40.

Yeah, somewhere around there. 38 to 39. And another little fella used to give me a hand, his name was Father Toots. He's still around somewhere around here. Around Jefferson, C.S.B.R. or Seasbury someplace. He's good too.
You know his real name? What his regular name is?
